originality.source: Owner confirmed no average loss; included as the pilot descriptive safeguard for final protocol approval.

analysis: Report individual paired scores, C coherence wins/ties/losses and mean paired originality. Describe the owner’s development sample; no formal gate pass, population claim or permission to bypass later gate prerequisites.

reading.scope_of_cap: Owner reading and answers; exclude agent work and voluntary breaks. Stop at the cap, including mid-pair if needed; preserve the fixed four-pair denominator and any missing scores. Do not ask for extra reading beyond the cap.
reading.condition_map: Sealed until the fixed sample is fully scored and the batch closed. No intermediate condition results or model explanations. Exact anonymous source context only.
reading.owner_code_work_time: Obtain actual information before opening the batch; unknown stays unknown.

generation.matching: All attributable input/output tokens, including repairs/regeneration/revisions/cache hits; tolerance 10%.
generation.admission: Every fixed pair must have successful generation, validated C plan, final selected prose within 10% of target and matched B/C budget before any owner reading.
generation.stopping: No extra seeds or literary rewrites; stop as incomplete if the fixed limits are exhausted. Any later attempt requires a separately recorded proposal, not an automatic budget increase.
generation.estimate_caveat: Projection from two dev pairs at configured prices; completion within cap is uncertain, and this is not a provider invoice.
generation.budget_owner_approval_verbatim: Yes, US$1.50 is fine for the pilot.

frozen_heldout_test_cohort: Untouched. No test generation or test tuning.
fixed_sample_rule: Four specified development pairs; no top-up, dropping, substitution or result-dependent sample selection.
owner_time_approval_verbatim: Yes, two hours total is the right cap for my part.
approval_record: Owner final approval will be recorded separately against the exact file checksums; this document alone does not authorise generation.
